items.q: Everett Johnson was one of those cats that could get out there and stretch out on Pete Johnson

ctx.x: Everett Johnson was one of those cats that could get out there and stretch out on Pete Johnson, and they'd battle all night. Yeah. He could really play barrelhouse and play some eight-to-the-bar blues and all that, you know.
Well, the time we're talking of, Pete Johnson was well known by then, was he?
